proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemRecord + magic_item_root family
proposed_widenings.justification: UnitRecord has no 'magic_item' kind. traceUnit() has no case for it. The v4 taxonomy lists magic_item_root as a source atom, but types.ts never defines MagicItemRecord or any magic-item mechanics family.
proposed_widenings.evidence: export type UnitRecord = SpellRecord | ClassFeatureRecord | MasteryRecord; (no MagicItemRecord)

proposed_widenings.name: ChargeResource (consumable single-use item)
proposed_widenings.justification: The bead is destroyed on activation — a single-charge consumable. The v4 atom 'charge' exists but types.ts has no ChargeResource or item-level use-count that maps to an item being consumed.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The bead explodes in a 10-foot-radius Sphere on impact and is destroyed.

proposed_widenings.name: barrier (or block_travel + block_targeting area)
proposed_widenings.justification: The item creates an impenetrable transparent force sphere that blocks attacks, effects, and egress. v4 lists block_travel and block_targeting as effect atoms, but neither is in the current Effect union in types.ts, and a persistent barrier enclosing an area is not representable.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Only breathable air can pass through the sphere's wall. No attack or other effect can pass through.

proposed_widenings.name: apply_condition / trap (containment)
proposed_widenings.justification: Creatures that fail the save and are completely within the area are trapped inside. This is not a named SRD condition; it is a movement-blocking containment state tied to the barrier object. Not representable as apply_condition (no matching Condition variant) nor as any current effect.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Any creature that failed the save and is completely within the area is trapped inside this sphere.

proposed_widenings.name: force_move (push away)
proposed_widenings.justification: Creatures that succeed the save or are partially inside are pushed away from the sphere's center. v4 lists force_move, but it is absent from the current Effect union in types.ts.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Creatures that succeeded on the save or are partially within the area are pushed away from the center of the sphere until they are no longer inside it.

proposed_widenings.name: mobile area attachment (sphere moveable by occupants)
proposed_widenings.justification: An enclosed creature can use a Utilize action to push the sphere up to half its Speed. The current Attachment area shape is a static origin; there is no grammar for an area that moves as a result of occupant actions.
proposed_widenings.evidence: An enclosed creature can take a Utilize action to push against the sphere's wall, moving the sphere up to half the creature's Speed.

notes: Primary blocker is structural: UnitRecord has no magic_item kind and the tracer has no handler for it. Secondary blockers (consumable resource, barrier/containment effects, force_move, mobile area) would each individually require surface or atom widening even after the structural gap is closed. The item's mechanics are fully deterministic and in-scope for core — this is not a dm_agenda case.
